extracted.name: Boba Smoothie
extracted.description: This easy Boba Smoothie recipe blends lemonade, frozen strawberries, and mango then poured over bursting boba pearls. It’s kid-friendly, fun to sip, and easy to customize!
ingredient_lines: ½ cup bursting boba pearls* ((120g) or brown sugar tapioca pearls*)
2 cups prepared lemonade ((480mL) or prepared jasmine or white tea)
heavy whipping cream (, half and half, or coconut milk)
instruction_lines: Add ¼ cup bursting boba to each cup.
Add lemonade and frozen fruit to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour over bursting boba.
Add a splash of cream, half and half, or coconut milk.
categories: how to make boba tea smoothie
